titleZh: TPG and Corpay agree to acquire and take private BILL Holdings
titleOriginal: TPG and Corpay agree to acquire and take private BILL Holdings, whose cloud-based software lets SMBs automate financial operations, in a deal valued at ~$6B (Pritam Biswas/Reuters)
summary: TPG和Corpay同意以约60亿美元估值收购并退市BILL Holdings，BILL Holdings提供云端软件，让中小企业自动化财务运营。交易由私募股权集团TPG与Corpay合作完成。
keyPoints: TPG和Corpay同意以约60亿美元估值收购BILL Holdings
交易将使BILL Holdings退市私有
BILL Holdings提供云端软件，让中小企业自动化财务运营
